title: Save and Fill Payment Methods
description: Learn how to securely save and automatically fill credit card information and other payment methods to streamline your online shopping experience.
content:
Save your payment methods securely and let your browser automatically fill them when you're ready to make a purchase. This feature helps you shop faster while keeping your payment information protected.

Oasis Feature

Oasis includes secure payment method autofill built on Firefox core technology. This feature helps protect your payment information while making online shopping more convenient.

What are Payment Methods?

Payment methods include credit cards, debit cards, and other payment information you use for online purchases. When saved securely, your browser can automatically fill this information during checkout.

Supported Payment Types

  • Credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, etc.)
  • Debit cards
  • Gift cards
  • Digital wallets
  • Bank account information

Information Stored

  • Card numbers (encrypted)
  • Expiration dates
  • Cardholder names
  • Billing addresses
  • Security codes (CVV)

Setting Up Payment Method Autofill

Follow these steps to enable and configure payment method autofill:

1

Enable Payment Autofill

Open your browser settings and navigate to Privacy & Security. Look for "Forms and Autofill" or "Payment Methods" and enable credit card autofill.

2

Add Your Payment Methods

Enter your credit card information when prompted during online purchases, or add payment methods manually in your browser settings.

3

Set Security Preferences

Choose whether to require confirmation before filling payment information and set up additional security measures like primary password protection.

4

Test Your Setup

Visit an online store and test the payment autofill to ensure it's working correctly and securely.

Adding Payment Methods

During Online Purchases

  • Enter payment information on a secure website
  • Look for the "Save this payment method" option
  • Confirm that you want to save the information
  • Verify the information is correct before saving
  • Choose whether to save billing address

Manual Addition

  • Access payment settings in browser preferences
  • Click "Add Payment Method" or similar option
  • Enter card details manually
  • Verify information accuracy
  • Set as default if desired

Security Features

Data Protection

  • All payment data is encrypted
  • Information stored locally on your device
  • Card numbers are masked in settings
  • Secure transmission during autofill
  • No data shared with websites automatically

Access Controls

  • Primary password protection
  • Confirmation prompts for payments
  • Session-based access control
  • Automatic logout after inactivity
  • Device-specific encryption

Using Payment Autofill

1

Checkout Process

When you reach the payment section of an online store, your browser will recognize the payment form and offer to fill your saved payment information.

2

Selection and Confirmation

Choose which saved payment method to use, or let the browser automatically select your default payment method. Confirm the selection if prompted.

3

Review and Complete

Review the filled information to ensure accuracy, make any necessary adjustments, and complete your purchase securely.

Managing Saved Payment Methods

Viewing and Editing

  • Access payment settings in browser preferences
  • View saved payment methods (numbers masked)
  • Edit cardholder names and billing addresses
  • Update expiration dates when needed
  • Set default payment methods

Removing Payment Methods

  • Delete expired or unused cards
  • Remove payment methods you no longer use
  • Clear all payment data if needed
  • Confirm deletion to prevent accidents
  • Update default payment method after removal

Privacy and Security Best Practices

Security Tips

  • Use a primary password to protect payment data
  • Only save payment methods on your personal devices
  • Regularly review and update saved information
  • Be cautious on public or shared computers
  • Monitor your accounts for unauthorized charges

Privacy Controls

  • Choose which websites can use payment autofill
  • Disable autofill for sensitive purchases
  • Clear payment data when needed
  • Control sync settings for payment information
  • Use incognito mode for sensitive transactions

Common Scenarios

Online Shopping

  • E-commerce websites and online stores
  • Subscription services and memberships
  • Digital downloads and software purchases
  • Travel bookings and reservations
  • Gift card and voucher purchases

Payment Forms

  • Credit card application forms
  • Utility and service payments
  • Donation and charity websites
  • Government and official payments
  • Educational and course payments

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  • Payment autofill not working on certain sites
  • Incorrect payment information being filled
  • Payment forms not being recognized
  • Security prompts appearing too frequently
  • Payment methods not saving properly

Solutions

  • Check payment autofill settings and permissions
  • Update saved payment information
  • Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Verify website security and compatibility
  • Check primary password and security settings

Advanced Features

Payment Preferences

  • Set default payment methods by type
  • Configure confirmation requirements
  • Set up payment method categories
  • Customize autofill behavior
  • Manage payment method priorities

Integration Features

  • Works with digital wallets
  • Compatible with payment processors
  • Supports multiple currencies
  • Integrates with shopping extensions
  • Works across different devices

What to Expect

When using payment method autofill, you may experience:

Convenience Benefits

  • Faster checkout process
  • Reduced typing and errors
  • Consistent payment information
  • Streamlined online shopping
  • Time savings on repetitive purchases

Security Considerations

  • Additional security prompts for payments
  • Need to keep payment information updated
  • Should be used carefully on shared devices
  • Requires regular security maintenance
  • May need to adjust settings over time

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on setting up and managing payment method autofill, visit Mozilla's official support guide:

Mozilla Credit Card Autofill Guide

Technical Details

Payment method autofill uses advanced security and form recognition technology:

How Payment Autofill Works

  • Form Recognition: Identifies payment form fields and their purpose
  • Data Encryption: Encrypts all payment information using strong algorithms
  • Secure Storage: Stores encrypted data locally on your device
  • Smart Matching: Matches form fields with appropriate saved payment data
  • Access Control: Requires authentication before accessing payment information

Since Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, payment method autofill provides the same secure and reliable payment capabilities with enhanced privacy protection.
